preconditions: Doctrine revision 6 is merged before repository creation.
The initial repository contains only the minimal packet contract and admitted packet content.
No package imports from or fetches the Data repository at runtime.
expected_postconditions: The repository is public with main as its default branch.
Management records the repository identity and exact initial commit.
Canonical packets are self-contained under packets/<packet-id>/<version>/.
EOS runtime copies and Validation evidence pin immutable Data inputs.
reversibility: Repository contents are reversible through Git. Repository deletion is not authorized; an erroneous creation must stop for user direction.
